releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.6.6 - Real-Time Zero Latency Audio & Jitter Drift Self-Healing
releases.summary: Eliminated audio delay and lag drift across phone mirror and browser overlays. Added 10ms micro-chunk capture with URGENT_AUDIO Linux process priority, auto-healing Web Audio jitter scheduling with 60ms hard drift ceiling, instant stale buffer purge, congestion delta-frame skipping, and seamless audio unmuting resync.
highlights: 10ms Low-Latency Audio Chunks: Android AudioRecord reads in 1,920-byte micro-buffers (10ms) instead of large 80ms-160ms blocking buffers, sending game audio instantly
Urgent Audio Thread Priority: Sets Android Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_URGENT_AUDIO so audio capture is never delayed by heavy 3D game rendering
Jitter Drift Self-Healing: Web Audio scheduler clamps max audio lead time to 60ms, instantly dropping queued lag and auto-resyncing to 20ms real-time
Stale Audio Node Purge: Automatically stops and disconnects all pending scheduled buffers upon resync to eliminate echo and overlapping
Congestion Protection: Skips non-keyframe video delta packets when socket queue exceeds 256KB, preventing audio packets from waiting behind video backlog
releases.notes: Critical update completely fixing audio delay and audio drift issues during screen mirroring.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.6.5 - True Fullscreen Borderless Gaming & Native 20:9 Landscape
releases.summary: Eliminated all letterbox borders and phone bezels for Mobile Legends and horizontal games. Hardware accelerometer sensor rotation with physical aspect ratio alignment (2400x1080), Level 5 AVC encoder profiling, default borderless landscape overlays, URL query parameter overrides, and floating quick controls.
highlights: Physical Hardware Aspect Ratio: Encoder streams exact 20:9/19.5:9 native phone glass dimensions (e.g. 2400x1080) eliminating black compression letterboxes
H.264 Level 5 Profile: Hardware encoder checks capability and scales macroblock limits smoothly for ultra-wide mobile displays
Hardware Accelerometer Rotation: Background service uses OrientationEventListener tilt sensors to reliably detect game rotation even with system auto-rotate lock
Default Borderless Landscape: phone.html overlay and desktop dashboard default to borderless landscape with object-fit controls (?frame=none, ?fit=cover)
In-Browser Quick Toolbar: Hover-to-reveal floating controls to switch borderless, landscape/portrait, fit cover/contain, and fullscreen directly in browser
releases.notes: Critical update eliminating all borders and letterbox bars for mobile gaming mirrors.

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.6.4 - Dynamic Landscape Auto-Rotate, Audio Unaligned Fix & 16:9 Gaming Mode
releases.summary: Fixed phone screen landscape letterboxing for Mobile Legends and horizontal games with dynamic DisplayListener sensor rotation, introduced 3-way Orientation Mode selector in Android app, eliminated unaligned 16-bit PCM audio decoding crash via DataView, and added adaptive 16:9 landscape stage preview.
highlights: Dynamic Display Rotation: Automatically detects device rotation changes via DisplayManager.DisplayListener and hot-reconfigures VideoEncoder and VirtualDisplay without disconnecting
Orientation Mode Selector: Added 3-way segmented control in Shing Cast app: Auto Sensor, Landscape 16:9 (Gaming), and Portrait 9:16 (Feed)
Internal Game Audio Fix: Eliminated 5-byte unaligned Int16Array RangeError crash by reading 16-bit PCM little-endian samples with DataView across OBS overlays and desktop dashboard
Dynamic Stage and Overlay Aspect Ratio: Desktop live preview stage and phone.html overlay adapt fluidly to 16:9 landscape or 9:16 portrait when phone orientation changes
Full Screen Borderless OBS Capture: phone-frame-none expands to full viewport without letterboxing

releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.6.3 - Shing Cast Hardware Video Fix & WebCodecs Auto-Healing
releases.summary: Resolved the phone screen mirroring issue by eliminating Chromium WebCodecs Annex B format conflicts, adding dynamic SPS parameter parsing, ISO AVCDecoderConfigurationRecord fallback, combined SPS/IDR buffer extraction, and instant keyframe caching for late-joining OBS sources.
highlights: WebCodecs Specification Compliance: Eliminated Annex B raw description conflict in Chromium VideoDecoder and implemented auto-healing dual-mode (Annex B + AVCC fallback)
Dynamic SPS Parameter Extraction: Dynamically parses profile_idc, constraint flags, and level_idc into accurate codec strings (e.g. avc1.42c028, avc1.640028)
Android Combined Buffer Detection: VideoEncoder detects combined SPS and IDR slice buffers and caches inline parameter sets for all Android chipsets
Zero-Latency OBS Join: OverlayServer caches last keyframe and configuration packets to render video on frame 0 when adding browser source
releases.notes: Critical fix for Shing Cast screen mirroring rendering with WebCodecs hardware decoding.
